time_basis: local apparent solar time, as in the period accounts
historical_end: about 20:00-21:00 (KRO: issue uncertain until 19:00-20:00; CDB active period ends 21:00)
weather: dry, sunny, warm; morning fog lifted before the march (CDB wx D/S/T; KRO)

strength_sources.prussia: CDB90 32,000 (KRO ~33,000); allocated to KRO's 32 bns, 116 sqns, 28 heavy pieces
strength_sources.austria: NAF 35,160 inf + 18,630 cav = 53,790, plus heavy-gun crews (KRO ~54,000); CDB90 44,000

projection.note: local x = easting - 501000, y = northing - 5538100; SW corner of the grid

changes.what: Křečhoř garrison and right flank (A-NAD Nádasdy's foot, A-MOR his horse) start 1.75 km south (four dragoon bodies of A-NOS stopped at the map's south edge)
changes.from: about Křečhoř and the oak wood
changes.why: the village and the oak wood become a race the Prussian vanguard can win by moving first

changes.what: Austrian centre and right (A-WIE, A-RWC, A-STA, A-AND) start 1 km south
changes.from: on the crest of the Křečhoř heights
changes.why: every objective was held at the start, so the attack had nothing to decide

changes.what: Prussian vanguard (P-VAN: Hülsen, Zieten's hussars) starts 700 m south
changes.to: south of the road toward the heights
changes.why: brings the first wave within reach of Křečhoř; measured with Austria at 0.81 in a variant whose four south-edge dragoon bodies stood off the map: 40% without it, 50% with it (25% once those bodies were put on the map)
